summary: First end-to-end test of Authix (Discord verification bot landing + API + bot). Backend APIs (6 pytest cases) all pass — /api/, /api/health (api:ok, mongo:ok), /api/stats (integers + 99.98 uptime), /api/commands (5 commands with /customization premium). Frontend landing page loads, hero title present, navbar links all present, hero add-to-discord CTA present, 6 feature cards render, stats loaded from API (uptime 99.98), commands list loaded from API with Premium badge only on /customization, Premium section shows Free/Premium plans, How-it-works captcha mockup flow works (open modal, submit KPXZQN, verified state shown). Docs page renders 6 setup steps (visually confirmed via screenshot). Authix bot supervisor process stays RUNNING without a token (logs 'DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN is not set' and sleeps — no crash loop).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI lifecycle @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager (non-blocking, informational).
bot.py: has_premium_entitlement falls back to guild owner when PREMIUM_SKU_ID is unset — intentional for dev, but worth a TODO/comment to avoid shipping that fallback to production.
No dedicated data-testid on Docs step cards; used textual heuristics. Adding data-testid="docs-step-N" would improve testability.
Frontend directly reads process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in multiple components — compliant with env-var policy; centralising in a single axios client could be considered later.
test_credentials: None required - all endpoints public. DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN intentionally blank (user said skip).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_authix_api.py and can be re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Public URL is https://bot-builder-111.preview.emergentagent.com. Captcha demo code is client-side hardcoded 'KPXZQN'. Authix bot will not connect to Discord until DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN is populated in /app/backend/.env and `sudo supervisorctl restart authix_bot` is executed. Docs page step headings use format '1.', '2.' ... '6.' (not zero-padded).
